name: How do professionals remove smoke odor from a garage?

mainEntity.name: How do professionals remove smoke odor from a garage?

acceptedAnswer.text: Professional smoke odor removal involves several steps. First, all sources of soot and smoke residue are thoroughly cleaned from surfaces, as these are the primary cause of persistent odors. Then, specialized equipment like hydroxyl generators or ozone machines are used to neutralize odor particles at a molecular level. Air scrubbers also help to filter the air. Finally, sealing any remaining porous materials can prevent odors from resurfacing.
acceptedAnswer.description: Professionals remove smoke odor by thoroughly cleaning soot and residue, then using specialized equipment like hydroxyl generators or ozone machines to neutralize odors.
